mapper.insert: INSERT INTO real_estate_transactions ( external_row_key, property_match_key, dataset_id, property_category, transaction_type, lawd_code, sgg_name, umd_name, jibun, address, display_name, name_source, area_m2, area_pyeong, floor, build_year, deal_date, deal_year_month, trade_amount_manwon, deposit_amount_manwon, monthly_rent_manwon, latitude, longitude, raw_json, fetched_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{externalRowKey}, #{propertyMatchKey}, #{datasetId}, #{propertyCategory}, #{transactionType}, #{lawdCode}, #{sggName}, #{umdName}, #{jibun}, #{address}, #{displayName}, #{nameSource}, #{areaM2}, #{areaPyeong}, #{floor}, #{buildYear}, #{dealDate}, #{dealYearMonth}, #{tradeAmountManwon}, #{depositAmountManwon}, #{monthlyRentManwon}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{rawJson}, #{fetchedAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE property_match_key = VALUES(property_match_key), dataset_id = VALUES(dataset_id), property_category = VALUES(property_category), transaction_type = VALUES(transaction_type), lawd_code = VALUES(lawd_code), sgg_name = VALUES(sgg_name), umd_name = VALUES(umd_name), jibun = VALUES(jibun), address = VALUES(address), display_name = VALUES(display_name), name_source = VALUES(name_source), area_m2 = VALUES(area_m2), area_pyeong = VALUES(area_pyeong), floor = VALUES(floor), build_year = VALUES(build_year), deal_date = VALUES(deal_date), deal_year_month = VALUES(deal_year_month), trade_amount_manwon = VALUES(trade_amount_manwon), deposit_amount_manwon = VALUES(deposit_amount_manwon), monthly_rent_manwon = VALUES(monthly_rent_manwon), latitude = VALUES(latitude), longitude = VALUES(longitude), raw_json = VALUES(raw_json), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT dataset_id AS datasetId, lawd_code AS lawdCode, bootstrap_started_at AS bootstrapStartedAt, last_synced_year_month AS lastSyncedYearMonth, bootstrap_completed_at AS bootstrapCompletedAt, last_result_message AS lastResultMessage, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM real_estate_sync_checkpoint WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND lawd_code = #{lawdCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO real_estate_sync_checkpoint ( dataset_id, lawd_code, bootstrap_started_at, last_result_message, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{datasetId}, #{lawdCode}, #{startedAt}, #{message}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bootstrap_started_at = COALESCE(bootstrap_started_at, VALUES(bootstrap_started_at)), last_result_message = VALUES(last_result_message), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)

INSERT INTO real_estate_sync_checkpoint ( dataset_id, lawd_code, last_synced_year_month, last_result_message, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{datasetId}, #{lawdCode}, #{lastSyncedYearMonth}, #{message}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_synced_year_month = VALUES(last_synced_year_month), last_result_message = VALUES(last_result_message), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)

INSERT INTO real_estate_sync_checkpoint ( dataset_id, lawd_code, last_synced_year_month, bootstrap_completed_at, last_result_message, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{datasetId}, #{lawdCode}, #{lastSyncedYearMonth}, #{completedAt}, #{message}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_synced_year_month = VALUES(last_synced_year_month), bootstrap_completed_at = VALUES(bootstrap_completed_at), last_result_message = VALUES(last_result_message), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
